learning_plane: warm-up: no priors in effect; these runs are folded, never measured
protocol: Warm-up for #140 (exploration by pinning, ADR 0038 decision (c)). Each run's configuration selects one (harness, model): selected_harnesses names only its harness and that harness's models list only its model; nothing else differs from meshloop.toml. Every run uses one shared repository and store, so the cell folds them together: before each run main becomes a single root commit holding the task's seed (the same tree and message a fresh repository gets). Protocol per run: review-plan --accept, run; no resume --retry (one candidate), no accept or integrate. A run's evidence is the attempt's deterministic check, which runs the task's verify.py, so check_result passed is a trusted verify.py pass in the attempt's worktree. Warm-up runs are never measured.
state_carried: One repository and store for every warm-up run (the cell folds one store). routing_feedback accumulates across warm-up runs, but a pinned run has one candidate, so it cannot change a choice.

overall.adjust_decline_note: 0 by protocol (fixed automated acceptance), not a human measurement
